pages.quiz:
GERMAN — MOCK EXAM #12
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: GERMAN
TIME ALLOWED: 90 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 80
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What does "der Stuhl" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. bathroom
   B. chair
   C. fridge
   D. plate

2. What does "der Herd" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. fridge
   B. bed
   C. cooker
   D. sofa

3. How is the "z" pronounced in "zehn" in the tongue twister about ten goats? (1 mark)
   A. like z in zoo
   B. like ts
   C. like sh
   D. like s

4. How is "j" pronounced in "ja"? (1 mark)
   A. like ch
   B. like zh
   C. like y
   D. like j in jam

5. How is the letter U named in German? (1 mark)
   A. ess
   B. oo
   C. bay
   D. yot

6. What does "der Opa" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. grandfather
   B. father
   C. sister
   D. family

7. What does "Es hat vier Zimmer" mean? (1 mark)
   A. It has four doors
   B. It has four rooms
   C. It has four beds
   D. It has four gardens

8. What is the plural of "das Buch"? (1 mark)
   A. die Buchs
   B. die Bücher
   C. die Buchen
   D. die Buche

9. Which month comes right after "November"? (1 mark)
   A. Juni
   B. Dezember
   C. Juli
   D. September

10. What does "der Käse" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. carrot
   B. cheese
   C. bread
   D. juice

11. Which little word goes with the noun "Tee"? (1 mark)
   A. das
   B. den
   C. die
   D. der

12. Which little word goes with the noun "Zahn"? (1 mark)
   A. die
   B. den
   C. der
   D. das

13. What does "trocken" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. sunny
   B. cloudy
   C. windy
   D. dry

14. What does "deckt den Tisch" mean? (1 mark)
   A. lays the table
   B. opens the door
   C. cleans the floor
   D. cooks the food

15. Which German word or phrase means "friend"? (1 mark)
   A. der Freund
   B. der Opa
   C. die Geschwister
   D. die Schwester

16. Which German word or phrase means "uncle"? (1 mark)
   A. die Eltern
   B. der Onkel
   C. die Familie
   D. der Bruder

17. What is the plural of "der Vater"? (1 mark)
   A. die Vateren
   B. die Vatere
   C. die Vaters
   D. die Väter

18. Which German word or phrase means "radio"? (1 mark)
   A. der Stuhl
   B. das Radio
   C. der Schrank
   D. der Teller

19. What is a "Lieblingszimmer"? (1 mark)
   A. a cold room
   B. a new room
   C. a big room
   D. a favourite room

20. What is the plural of "der Baum"? (1 mark)
   A. die Bäume
   B. die Bäumen
   C. die Baums
   D. die Baume

21. What does "der zehnte" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. tenth
   B. fourth
   C. fifth
   D. second

22. Which German word means "September"? (month) (1 mark)
   A. September
   B. Juni
   C. November
   D. August

23. What does "der fünfte" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. seventh
   B. third
   C. fifth
   D. sixth

24. Which little word goes with the noun "Kohl"? (1 mark)
   A. der
   B. den
   C. das
   D. die

25. Which little word goes with the noun "Tomate"? (1 mark)
   A. den
   B. die
   C. das
   D. der

26. Which German word or phrase means "rice"? (1 mark)
   A. der Reis
   B. die Wassermelone
   C. die Mango
   D. die Banane

27. Which little word goes with the noun "Fuß"? (1 mark)
   A. die
   B. den
   C. der
   D. das

28. Which little word goes with the noun "Gesicht"? (1 mark)
   A. das
   B. den
   C. der
   D. die

29. Which German word or phrase means "thunderstorm"? (1 mark)
   A. das Wetter
   B. das Gewitter
   C. die Wolke
   D. der Regenbogen

30. How do you ask "Where is the ball?" (1 mark)
   A. Was ist der Ball?
   B. Wer ist der Ball?
   C. Wo ist der Ball?
   D. Wie ist der Ball?

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
31. Write the German words with der, die or das for: grandmother, clock. (2 marks)

32. Write the German words with der, die or das for: face, father. (2 marks)

33. Explain why "Meine Mutter sind nett" is wrong and correct it. (2 marks)

34. Unscramble the words: SICHT and TETB. Write them with their articles. (2 marks)

35. Give two safety rules for sending messages online. (2 marks)

36. Write the German words with der, die or das for: cupboard or wardrobe, weather, back, sugar, child. (5 marks)

37. Write the German words with der, die or das for: eye, neck, friend, uncle. (4 marks)

38. Give three tips for reading a tongue twister well. (3 marks)

39. Write the German words with der, die or das for: lamp, tomato. (2 marks)

40. Rewrite correctly: "guten abend otieno" (2 marks)

41. Write the German words with der, die or das for: rice, breakfast, table, fridge, kitchen. (5 marks)

42. Write these numbers in German: 1, 15, 20. (3 marks)

43. Write the German sound for each letter group: ei and ie. Give an example word for each. (2 marks)

44. Write the German words with der, die or das for: bedroom, chair, window, watermelon. (4 marks)

45. Write a short German dialogue of three lines in which two children greet each other, ask their names and answer. (3 marks)

46. Write the German words with der, die or das for: onion, parents, ear. (3 marks)

47. Write the German words with der, die or das for: shower, bean. (2 marks)

48. Write the German words with der, die or das for: cocoa, party. (2 marks)
pages.answers:
GERMAN — MOCK EXAM #12 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. B — chair
   der Stuhl means chair.

2. C — cooker
   der Herd means cooker.

3. B — like ts
   z sounds like ts, so zehn is tsayn.

4. C — like y
   German j sounds like the English y.

5. B — oo
   In German the letter U is called oo.

6. A — grandfather
   der Opa means grandfather.

7. B — It has four rooms
   hat = has, vier = four, Zimmer = rooms.

8. B — die Bücher
   The plural of das Buch is die Bücher.

9. B — Dezember
   After November comes Dezember.

10. B — cheese
   der Käse means cheese.

11. D — der
   It is der Tee, so the little word is der.

12. C — der
   It is der Zahn, so the little word is der.

13. D — dry
   trocken means dry.

14. A — lays the table
   den Tisch decken means to lay the table.

15. A — der Freund
   friend in German is der Freund.

16. B — der Onkel
   uncle in German is der Onkel.

17. D — die Väter
   The plural of der Vater is die Väter.

18. B — das Radio
   radio in German is das Radio.

19. D — a favourite room
   Liebling means favourite and Zimmer means room.

20. A — die Bäume
   The plural of der Baum is die Bäume.

21. A — tenth
   der zehnte means tenth.

22. A — September
   September in German is September.

23. C — fifth
   der fünfte means fifth.

24. A — der
   It is der Kohl, so the little word is der.

25. B — die
   It is die Tomate, so the little word is die.

26. A — der Reis
   rice in German is der Reis.

27. C — der
   It is der Fuß, so the little word is der.

28. A — das
   It is das Gesicht, so the little word is das.

29. B — das Gewitter
   thunderstorm in German is das Gewitter.

30. C — Wo ist der Ball?
   wo means where.

SECTION B
----
31. (2 marks)
   Answer: die Oma, die Uhr.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (2 marks).

32. (2 marks)
   Answer: das Gesicht, der Vater.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (2 marks).

33. (2 marks)
   Answer: With one person we use ist. Correct: Meine Mutter ist nett.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the reason and 1 mark for the correction.

34. (2 marks)
   Answer: der Tisch, das Bett.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with article.

35. (2 marks)
   Answer: Write only to people you know; do not share private information; ask an adult first.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each rule.

36. (5 marks)
   Answer: der Schrank, das Wetter, der Rücken, der Zucker, das Kind.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (5 marks).

37. (4 marks)
   Answer: das Auge, der Hals, der Freund, der Onkel.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (4 marks).

38. (3 marks)
   Answer: Read slowly at first; add a few words at a time; speed up only when it is clear.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each sensible tip.

39. (2 marks)
   Answer: die Lampe, die Tomate.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (2 marks).

40. (2 marks)
   Answer: Guten Abend, Otieno!
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for capital letters and 1 mark for punctuation.

41. (5 marks)
   Answer: der Reis, das Frühstück, der Tisch, der Kühlschrank, die Küche.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (5 marks).

42. (3 marks)
   Answer: eins, fünfzehn, zwanzig.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correctly spelled number.

43. (2 marks)
   Answer: ei sounds like eye (nein). ie sounds like ee (Tier).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct sound with an example.

44. (4 marks)
   Answer: das Schlafzimmer, der Stuhl, das Fenster, die Wassermelone.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (4 marks).

45. (3 marks)
   Answer: A: Hallo! Wie heißt du? B: Ich heiße Otieno. A: Ich heiße Amina.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the greeting, 1 mark for the question Wie heißt du?, 1 mark for the answer with Ich heiße.

46. (3 marks)
   Answer: die Zwiebel, die Eltern, das Ohr.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (3 marks).

47. (2 marks)
   Answer: die Dusche, die Bohne.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (2 marks).

48. (2 marks)
   Answer: der Kakao, die Party.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (2 marks).
